_comment: Scheduled FOMC DECISION (announcement) dates for strategies/prefomc/prefomc_alert.py.
SELF-CONTAINED on purpose: nothing else reads or checks this list (no botfolio / fleet link).
Scheduled meetings only; never add an unscheduled / emergency meeting.
Check after any edit: python strategies/prefomc/prefomc_alert.py --check-calendar
TO ADD A YEAR: put the Fed's dates under decisions.<year>. If they are not final, also add
the year to tentative_years: every SELL for a tentative year says so.
_tentative_note: 2027 is TENTATIVE until the Fed publishes its calendar. When it does: fix any date that moved, remove "2027" from tentative_years, run --check-calendar.
